whats.Indian companies trust AI with greater a: Trusting AI with more freedom is not enough. Managers still need to show what it earns or saves the business.
whats.Dun & Bradstreet Survey Highlights India: A survey points to an AI readiness gap in India, so check your own team's skills and data before making big bets.
whats.Securonix CPO on the limits of AI in sec: Even in security work, AI has limits. Know what it can and cannot do before you rely on it for protection.
whats.AI sell-off may not bring foreign invest: Bernstein warns that an AI sell-off may not bring foreign investors back to India. Useful context for leaders watching investor mood.
whats.Google Cloud’s Vision AI can cut manufac: The Tribune reports Vision AI could cut factory downtime and costs by up to 30%. Ask vendors for proof in your own setting.

term.def: Computer vision is AI that looks at images or video and understands what is in them. For example, it can spot a faulty part on a factory line.

prompt.prompt: Act as a finance analyst. Help me build a simple one page case showing the return on our [AI tool] pilot in [team]. Ask me for costs, time saved and risks, then draft the summary.

quiz.q: ANI News reports that Indian companies trust AI with greater autonomy but struggle to prove financial returns.
quiz.why: This is what the headline says. It reminds managers to track clear numbers for any AI project, not just enthusiasm.

quiz.q: The Tribune reports that Google Cloud's Vision AI can cut manufacturing downtime and operating costs by up to 30%.
quiz.why: That is the headline claim. 'Up to' means results vary, so ask any vendor to prove it in your own setting.

quiz.q: If an AI tool gives a confident answer, you can trust that it is correct.
quiz.why: AI can sound sure and still be wrong. Always check important facts, numbers and names before you use them.

quiz.q: You need to know how to write code to get real value from everyday AI tools.
quiz.why: Most popular AI tools work with plain language instructions. Clear writing matters far more than coding skill.

quiz.q: Telling an AI tool your goal and your audience usually makes its answer more useful.
quiz.why: AI works better with context. The more clearly you describe what you need and who it is for, the better the result.
